correctness.rationale: An exact normalized pmf on all integers yields a rational characteristic function with exact verified A/B factorizations. The positive phase admits an absolutely convergent cosine logarithm. Infinite divisibility is equivalent to all Fourier Levy coefficients being nonnegative; this holds iff |s|<=r. Exact positive polynomial identities and a unique quintic root give the complete necessity and sufficiency, including the boundary and a second sharp zero threshold. A rational example verifies a negative fourth harmonic, and the standalone checker passes all structural identities and brackets. Numerical samples are not used in place of proof.

originality.rationale: The full 2023 originating PDF states the exact SPL mass, gives transforms/log-concavity and identifies decomposability as further work. Actual published mathematical research index searches and recoverable own claims found no equivalent or stronger all-parameter infinite-divisibility classification; closest related models have different support or generating mechanisms. The exact quintic boundary, bilateral Levy intensities and zero-free non-divisible phase were not found in the inspected primary material. Related 2022 full texts remain inaccessible, so priority is best-knowledge, not absolute.

value.rationale: Original SPL authors explicitly propose studying discrete decomposability. The exact all-parameter transition answers that natural gap, the bilateral Levy measure supports stochastic construction, and two distinct Fourier phases separate the strictly positive characteristic-function criterion from true infinite divisibility. The nontrivial interval of log-concave but non-divisible distributions provides a motivated structural boundary rather than a routine special-case computation.
